test_plan.introduction: IEEE 829 integration test plan for Yoklama shareable setup (REQ-yoklama-setup / EPIC-1). Designed test-first against PLAN-yoklama-setup and the reviewed FRD. The BA Gherkin set (@TC-BE-001..016 / @TC-FE-001..014 in docs/analysis/yoklama-setup/test/testcases-yoklama-setup.en.md) is the acceptance layer; this plan is the integration layer. Cases reference those ids in steps and trace plan ACs as TASK-KEY#ACn. Design effort is on isolated-temp-DB execution, fill-gaps/monthly ordinal, operator upgrade insert (ADR-0001), stdlib import transport (ADR-0002), Settings vs wizard shared series, people 409, live-tick non-regression, and the HTTP error-code matrix. NFR-001 is one non-gating smoke case. Architect ADRs 0001/0002/0003 are in force.
test_items: TASK-1.1.1 — meeting series fill-gaps (none/weekly/biweekly/monthly, skip existing ISO date, never DELETE, kind=series)
TASK-1.1.2 — GroupProfile SQLite singleton, first-run wizard gate, ADR-0001 upgrade insert, 127.0.0.1 bind
TASK-1.2.1 — Settings + header group name + live-tick preserve + NFR-001 smoke
TASK-1.2.2 — roster import (CSV/JSON/xlsx, all-or-nothing upsert) + README/git contract
TASK-1.2.3 — people POST/PUT/DELETE (409 duplicate, immutable sicil, cascade delete)
Local Python app at http://127.0.0.1:8765 driven from an isolated temp tree so the operator Grup 8 database is never the test DB
features_to_test: Empty-clone first-run wizard vs configured meeting list (ADR-0001)
Operator upgrade: meetings exist, no profile → default singleton insert, no series, no wizard
seed/people.json filling an empty people table does not skip the wizard
Don't-repeat / weekly / biweekly / monthly fill-gaps per ADR-0003, including fifth-weekday month skip
end_date < first_date rejected with no profile or meeting writes
Shortening end date never deletes meetings or attendance; no UNIQUE(date)
Generated meetings kind=series; POST /api/meetings extras stay extra
Valid profile+series commit independent of a later rejected import (two transactions)
Settings reuses the same fill-gaps and date-reject rules; header shows group name
Live joined/absent tick, tags, notes, copyable summaries, extra meeting CUD unchanged
NFR-001: one attendance mark on ≤80 people persists (manual/smoke, not a flaky gate)
Import upsert by sicil/id from CSV, people.json, simple first-sheet xlsx; absentees not deleted
All-or-nothing import validation; exotic xlsx fail-closed to CSV; numeric sicil without .0; UTF-8 BOM
JSON body import (not multipart); stdlib-only; no requirements.txt
People add/edit/delete; 409 on duplicate id; sicil disabled on edit; confirm cascade
Turkish wizard, Settings, and people forms; empty roster is valid
Position/center visible on people row, person report, and live roster when present
Loopback bind 127.0.0.1 not 0.0.0.0; no password; git omits data/*.db and real seed/people.json
features_not_to_test: Hosted multi-user product, login, Teams auto-attendance, guests, managers as app users (FRD out of scope)
Operator Grup 8 production PII — tests use only synthetic fixtures on a temp tree
OpenAPI / ba-services contracts — none exist; routes extend existing JSON Handler
NFR-001 as an automated wall-clock pass/fail gate (architect F-5) — TC-22 records elapsed time as smoke only

The BA Gherkin scenarios as a separately executed suite — they are the acceptance layer; this plan executes the equivalent integration procedures and points at @TC-BE-* / @TC-FE-* (see excluded_coverage)
pip/openpyxl Excel engine and multipart upload — forbidden by ADR-0002
UNIQUE(date) on meetings — must remain absent (ADR-0003 / F-9)
test_plan.approach: Every case runs against an isolated temp copy of the project (rsync excluding data/*.db and seed/people.json) so the operator Grup 8 SQLite file is never opened. Start with `python3 app.py` from that temp root; BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765. If port 8765 is busy, stop the leftover Yoklama process for the run — do not point tests at the operator data directory. If the deliverable documents YOKLAMA_DATA_DIR / YOKLAMA_DB, set it to a temp path instead of copying the tree. Technique: curl (or equivalent HTTP) for profile/series/import/people/meta/meetings/attendance; playwright-cli for wizard, Settings, people UI, header, and live-tick regression. Harness contract (substitute documented names and record the substitution): GET /api/meta includes configured (bool) and groupName (string), and may include firstDate, endDate, repeatRule; PUT /api/profile body {name, firstDate, endDate|null, repeatRule: none|weekly|biweekly|monthly} is the wizard and Settings save; POST /api/people/import JSON {filename, text} or {filename, contentBase64} — never multipart; POST /api/people add; PUT /api/people/{id} edit (id only in path); DELETE /api/people/{id}; existing GET /api/people, GET /api/meetings, POST /api/meetings (kind extra), PUT /api/meetings/{id}/attendance/{personId}, GET /api/meetings/{id}/roster remain. Validation may be HTTP 400 or 422 unless an AC requires 409. Playwright: Chromium against BASE_URL; hashes #/ meeting list, #/settings Settings, #/people people, #/meeting/:id live roster; wizard is the first view when configured=false (overlay or #/setup). Assert Turkish product copy, not screens.md English. Synthetic PII only (@example.com, fictional names, sicil 10001+).
test_plan.pass_fail_criteria: A case passes when every step assertion holds. Profile/series rejects must leave group_profile and meetings unchanged (row counts and ids). Import rejects must leave people unchanged. Delete-cancel must leave person and attendance. Bind case fails if the process listens on 0.0.0.0 or requires a password. TC-22 (NFR-001) PASSES if the mark persists and the row updates; elapsed >1s is recorded as a WARNING not a FAIL unless the save hangs beyond 5s. The test item corresponding to a task passes when every case tracing that task's ACs passes. Do not treat BA Gherkin ids as executed unless the matching integration case passed.
test_plan.suspension_resumption: Suspend if python3 app.py cannot bind 127.0.0.1:8765, if tests would have to use the operator data/attendance.db, if the deliverable has no profile-save or people-write route (precondition-blocked, kind: env), or if any case writes into BASE/data. Resume when an isolated temp tree runs and the harness contract routes respond. Re-run TC-1, TC-9, TC-11, TC-17 as the foundation gate before the rest.
test_plan.environmental_needs: macOS/Linux, Python 3 stdlib, curl, sqlite3 CLI, git (for TC-30 against the real repo root, read-only). Playwright Chromium via npx --yes playwright install chromium (or python -m playwright). Network only for Playwright browser install; the app itself needs no egress. Writable /tmp for TEST_ROOT. Fixture recipe for a minimal first-sheet xlsx (stdlib zipfile+xml, no openpyxl) and a macro-ish xlsx (add xl/vbaProject.bin) live in TC-24/TC-27 test_data. Project root for git ls-files: /Users/cagri.gider/Documents/AI_Champions/attendance. Never commit test DBs or real rosters.
risks: Route names are a harness contract — implementation may use POST /api/setup instead of PUT /api/profile. Contingency: qa-engineer substitutes documented paths and records them; cases are not skipped.

Wizard intercept DOM is unspecified (overlay vs #/setup). Contingency: assert via GET /api/meta configured=false PLUS UI that the meeting list is not the first screen (no meeting cards as the initial main view).
HTTP 400 vs 422 for date/import/people validation is unspecified except 409 for duplicate add. Contingency: accept 400 or 422; require 409 for TASK-1.2.3#AC2.
NFR-001 wall-clock is machine-dependent. Contingency: TC-22 is smoke/warning, not a suite gate (architect F-5).
Operator DB accident. Contingency: isolated TEST_ROOT; suspension if BASE/data would be opened.
Fifth-Wednesday monthly skip depends on ADR-0003 arithmetic. Contingency: dates in TC-4 are fixed; do not re-guess the rule.
Playwright file-input on wizard/Settings may need a real FileChooser. Contingency: API import (TC-16/TC-24) still certifies backend; UI cases fail only the UI AC if the picker is missing.

test_cases.title: Monthly uses weekday plus week-of-month ordinal and skips months with no such day
test_cases.setup: Two fresh isolated trees (or reset DB between substeps). python3 app.py each time.
steps: Ordinal happy path: PUT profile firstDate 2026-09-09 (2nd Wednesday, (9-1)//7+1=2), endDate 2026-11-11, repeatRule monthly. GET meetings.
Assert dates exactly 2026-09-09, 2026-10-14 (2nd Wednesday of October), 2026-11-11 (2nd Wednesday of November). No 2026-10-09 (calendar-day-of-month) and no weekly 2026-09-16.
Fifth-weekday skip: new empty DB. PUT firstDate 2026-09-30 (5th Wednesday), endDate 2026-12-31, monthly.
Assert meetings on 2026-09-30 and 2026-12-30 only (October and November 2026 have no fifth Wednesday). No dates outside firstDate..endDate.
test_cases.test_data: ADR-0003: ordinal (day-1)//7+1. 2026-09-09=2nd Wed; 2026-09-30=5th Wed. Synthetic name Grup 5.
test_cases.expected_result: Second-Wednesday series hits Sep 9, Oct 14, Nov 11. Fifth-Wednesday series skips Oct and Nov, keeps Sep 30 and Dec 30.

test_cases.title: App accepts 127.0.0.1 and does not listen on 0.0.0.0; no password
